we have measured the string tension, the 0 ++ and the 1 ++ glueball masses and the finite size effects on all these quantities.

the study of the properties of the strong interaction in the low-energy regime.
the properties of the SU(3) Yang-Mills gauge theory in four-dimensional Euclidean space-time.
the study of the strong interactions in the framework of quantum chromodynamics (QCD).

the results are consistent with the expectations of the string model and the glueball masses are consistent with the predictions of the bag model.

we have not been able to find the continuum limit for the string tension or the glueball mass.
